sentences.text: The Directors Guild of America -LRB- DGA -RRB- is an entertainment guild which represents the interests of film and television directors in the United States motion picture industry and abroad .	guild	guild	film	film director	television	television director	motion picture	motion picture
Founded as the Screen Directors Guild in 1936 , the group merged with the Radio and Television Directors Guild in 1960 to become the modern Directors Guild of America .
